scope.estimand: Probability of a large issuer loss conditional on a publicly disclosed biotech/pharma clinical-trial event.
not_estimating: Clinical efficacy or probability of regulatory approval
The causal effect of trial biology on issuer returns
Tradable alpha or an investable policy return
scope.cohort_limitation: The current 26-disclosure ledger is manually curated and selected for source traceability. It is not a representative event cohort and is ineligible for fitting under the sample gates.

event_and_feature_timing.event_time_source: Independently verified issuer, sponsor, or institutional disclosure; registry completion/results dates are not substituted for the disclosure timestamp.
event_and_feature_timing.date_only_policy: Use the first exchange session on or after the source date, preserve date-only precision, and interpret the event at date-level only; do not infer intraday ordering.
event_and_feature_timing.feature_cutoff: Prior US regular-session close, 16:00 America/New_York, strictly before the event window; source availability and record hashes are required.
forbidden_inputs: Current registry fields unless an archived version proves availability before feature_cutoff
Publications or evidence first available after feature_cutoff
The realized future event date as an observable prediction schedule

primary.definition: Indicator that adjusted issuer close-to-close return from the last pre-event close through the second close on or after the event date is at most -10%.
primary.interpretation: Event-conditioned downside forecast; not a strategy return.

predeclared_sensitivity.definition: Indicator that the two-session additive SPY/XBI market-model cumulative abnormal return is at most -10%.
predeclared_sensitivity.interpretation: Outcome sensitivity only; use the same folds and feature policy as the primary target.

targets.market_model: Estimate issuer returns on SPY and XBI over sessions -230 through -31, with a 30-session gap and at least 120 complete observations.

data_eligibility.prices: Locally licensed adjusted_close bars with a provider manifest whose SHA-256 matches the CSV; require event issuers, explicitly related issuers, SPY, and XBI.
data_eligibility.events: Unique event_id and source URL; one issuer-event row per independently market-relevant disclosure, with linked trials recorded as related_nct_ids rather than duplicated return labels.
data_eligibility.trial_features: Only archived pre-event trial versions with verified public_available_at_utc and record_sha256.
data_eligibility.research_features: Curated, dated evidence with source hash, evidence class, role, and explicit design/population/endpoint context; no abstract/title-derived score.
data_eligibility.overlap: Do not duplicate a disclosure across linked NCT records. Purge training labels whose matched_second_session reaches or overlaps the start of a test block.

features.selection_rule: Use only available columns from the fixed allowlist plus all panel columns beginning research_numeric_ and ending _median, sorted lexicographically. Record the realized feature list and panel checksum. Require at least two features. No text or outcome fields are eligible.
features.fold_local_preprocessing: Median imputation with missingness indicators, then standard scaling, fitted separately inside each training fold.

development_evaluation.date_unit: Distinct event_date clusters; never split rows from the same date across train and test.
development_evaluation.final_holdout_policy: Last 20% of distinct event dates remains unopened during development, feature/model changes, and calibration; the development command does not score or export its labels.
development_evaluation.fold_scheme: Expanding chronological windows over the first 80% of distinct event dates. Initial training window is the first 40% of development dates; remaining development dates are divided chronologically into three test blocks.
development_evaluation.purge: Training matched_second_session must be strictly earlier than the first test event date.
development_evaluation.skip_rule: A fold is not scored unless it meets both event-count minima and training data contain both target classes; if no fold qualifies, fail without fitting or lowering thresholds.

models_and_metrics.secondary_metric: ROC AUC only when a test fold contains both target classes.
models_and_metrics.calibration: Five fixed-width bins, development out-of-sample predictions only; do not include final holdout values.
baselines: Training-only pre-event volatility tertiles, shrunk to the fold base rate with prior strength 5
Training-only archived trial phase groups, shrunk to the fold base rate with prior strength 5
models_and_metrics.model: Median imputation with missingness indicators, standard scaling, and L2 logistic regression with C=1.0, max_iter=2000, random_state=0.
models_and_metrics.uncertainty: Paired issuer x calendar-quarter pigeonhole bootstrap of baseline-minus-model score improvement; 1,000 repetitions, seed 2026. Withhold intervals unless at least 10 issuer and 10 calendar-quarter clusters exist and sparse crossings permit at least 80% of requested draws.
models_and_metrics.interpretation_rule: Brier improvement over the training-fold base rate is primary; log-loss, other baselines, per-fold scores, calibration, and cluster counts must be shown. Do not claim a signal from a pooled score alone or from an interval withheld for sparse clusters.

strategy_and_rl_boundary.rl_reward: Finite-horizon sum of log(1 + net_return), gamma=1; equals log terminal wealth.
strategy_scorecard: Benchmark-relative compounded wealth on aligned dates
Expected shortfall, turnover, exposure, and risk-limit breaches
strategy_and_rl_boundary.deployment_claim: No trading-edge or deployment claim without a separately frozen chronological final evaluation, point-in-time data, licensed prices, realistic execution costs, benchmark-relative results, and risk metrics.
